summary: Enerflex Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with an accompanying exhibit announcing a director resignation. The filing does not provide any detail beyond the resignation itself; no price, stake, premium, or transaction terms are specified. There is no board recommendation or advisor named. As a Canadian foreign private issuer, this Form 6-K serves the same function as a U.S. Form 8-K Item 5.02 disclosure of a director departure. The event is limited to the management change; no broader special situation (e.g., acquisition, activist campaign) is indicated. What to watch: any subsequent filings explaining the reason for the resignation or any related party transactions.
